title: Little Space Lab
hook: Look up high, then name what you see!
Sky-full words from A to Z!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: clean 3D preschool space-science lab storybook, bright consoles and star windows, toy-like equipment, strong foreground separation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: curious child astronaut and calm mission guide
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 should feel like opening new spacecraft windows: vary direct calls, repeated letters, questions and short cinematic reveals; every target gets one real space clue or function.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 strips back to cue-gap-answer timing with orbit, point, trace or launch-like pretend gestures that never obscure the word.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: short synth-star ping or glockenspiel orbit after each target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: short synth-star ping or glockenspiel orbit after each target
